versions.content: If UdpNmPnEiraCalcEnabled is TRUE, the UdpNm shall provide the possibility to store external and internal requested PNs combined over all relevant channels (all UdpNm Channels where UdpNmPnEnabled is TRUE). At initialization the values of all PNs shall be set to 0 (not requested)

If UdpNmPnEiraCalcEnabled is TRUE, the UdpNm shall provide the possibility to store external and internal requested PNs combined over all relevant channels (all UdpNm Channels where UdpNmPnEnabled is TRUE). At initialization the values of all PNs shall be set to 0 (not requested)

{OBSOLETE} If UdpNmPnEiraCalcEnabled is TRUE, the UdpNm shall provide the possibility to store external and internal requested PNs combined over all relevant channels (all UdpNm Channels where UdpNmPnEnabled is TRUE). At initialization the values of all PNs shall be set to 0 (not requested)
